hospitals.name: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre
hospitals.notes: Unit of Tata Memorial Centre (TMC) Mumbai — operates under TMH standards. Closest TMC-network hospital for North Bihar patients. Highly recommended first stop for North Bihar.

hospitals.name: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Patna
hospitals.notes: Government tertiary institute. Linear accelerator + brachytherapy. Specialised clinics: head & neck, breast, pediatric oncology. Book via AIIMS ORS portal (ors.gov.in). Low cost, long wait times. Not NABH but NABL and AERB licensed.

hospitals.name: Mahavir Cancer Sansthan & Research Centre

key_doctors.name: Dr. Manisha Singh
key_doctors.role: Medical Director & HOD Medical Oncology — DNB, ESMO certified

hospitals.notes: Bihar's dedicated super-specialty cancer centre. 618 beds. Free treatment for children under 18. Rs 10,000 grant for low-income adults. Dharmashala (low-cost lodging) available for outstation patients. ~7km from Patna Junction.

hospitals.name: Paras HMRI Hospital — Paras Cancer Centre

key_doctors.name: Dr. Abhishek Anand
key_doctors.role: Director & HOD Medical Oncology — DM Medical Oncology, solid tumors, lymphomas, stem cell transplants

key_doctors.name: Dr. Shekhar Kumar Keshri
key_doctors.role: Director & HOD Radiation Oncology — 21+ years, SBRT, SRS

key_doctors.name: Dr. Mitali Dandekar Lall
key_doctors.role: Chief Consultant & HOD Surgical Oncology — Head & Neck specialist

key_doctors.name: Dr. R. N. Tagore
key_doctors.role: Chief Consultant Medical Oncology — 31 years experience

key_doctors.name: Dr. Mosarrat Shaheen
key_doctors.role: Consultant Medical Oncology — Precision Oncology, immunotherapy

hospitals.notes: First NABH-accredited hospital in Bihar. Has LINAC, PET-CT, Gamma Camera. Bone marrow transplant for leukemia/lymphoma. High cost — check PMJAY empanelment before visiting.

hospitals.name: Jay Prabha Medanta Super Specialty Hospital

key_doctors.name: Dr. Ravi Shankar Singh
key_doctors.role: Medical Director & Senior Medical Oncologist — solid tumors

key_doctors.name: Dr. Rajiv Ranjan Prasad
key_doctors.role: Director Radiation Oncology — 30+ years, IMRT, IGRT, SRS

key_doctors.name: Dr. Sundeep Kumar
key_doctors.role: Associate Director Surgical Oncology — GI, Gynae, Head & Neck, robotic

key_doctors.name: Dr. Amarendra Amar
key_doctors.role: Associate Director Medical Oncology — prostate, breast, immunotherapy

key_doctors.name: Dr. Niharika Roy
key_doctors.role: Senior Consultant Breast Services — oncoplastic surgery

hospitals.notes: Largest private hospital in Patna. NABH + NABL. Has Varian Edge radiation machine (first in Eastern India). Da Vinci robotic surgery for oncology. High cost.

hospitals.name: Ruban Memorial Hospital

key_doctors.name: Dr. Arun Pandey
key_doctors.role: Director & HOD Surgical Oncology & Robotic Surgery

hospitals.notes: 450-bed quaternary care. High-volume robotic surgery centre for prostate, kidney, colorectal, gynecologic cancers. Strong for surgical cases — limited medical oncology compared to Paras/Medanta.

hospitals.name: Buddha Cancer Centre

key_doctors.name: Dr. Arvind Kumar
key_doctors.role: Founder Director & Senior Medical Oncologist — first DM Medical Oncology in Bihar, AIIMS Delhi alumnus

key_doctors.name: Dr. Rahul Kumar Chaudhary
key_doctors.role: Surgical Oncology — gallbladder cancer specialist, fellowship Japan

key_doctors.name: Dr. Rayaz Ahmed
key_doctors.role: Senior Hematologist — DM CMC Vellore, bone marrow transplants

hospitals.notes: NABH Recommended (Nov 2023). Has NGS genetic testing. Dedicated pain & palliative care clinic. Medium cost — more affordable than Paras/Medanta for medical oncology cases.

hospitals.name: S.S. Hospital & Research Centre

key_doctors.name: Dr. J.K. Singh
key_doctors.role: Director & Senior Oncologist — Padma Shri awardee, 49+ years experience

key_doctors.name: Dr. Sweta Das
key_doctors.role: Medical & Clinical Oncology — also Clinical Geneticist

hospitals.notes: NABH Recommended (Apr 2024). Led by Dr. J.K. Singh — Padma Shri, one of Bihar's most respected oncologists. Day-care chemo unit with zero drug wastage policy.

hospitals.name: Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences (State Cancer Institute)
hospitals.notes: Designated Regional Cancer Centre. Subsidized / free treatment for low-income patients. OPD Mon–Fri 8:30am–4:30pm, Sat till noon. Not NABH accredited. Quality variable — recommended as option when Mahavir/AIIMS Patna is not accessible.
hospitals.risk_flag: Quality concerns — use with caution; verify department capacity before referral

hospitals.name: Healing Touch Hospital

key_doctors.name: Dr. Siddharth Jai Singh
key_doctors.role: Consultant Urologist — kidney, bladder, prostate cancers

hospitals.notes: First NABH-accredited hospital in Bhagalpur. Best option for surgical oncology and uro-oncology for patients in East Bihar (Bhagalpur, Munger, Banka). Refer to Patna/Muzaffarpur for radiation or medical oncology.

hospitals.name: Narayana Cancer Centre, Patna
hospitals.notes: NABH Recommended (Feb 2025). Part of Narayana Health group. Doctor list to be verified.

hospitals.name: Atlantis Super Speciality Hospital
hospitals.notes: NABH Accredited. Dr. Rohan Singh trained at Tata Memorial. Limited to medical oncology — refer surgical cases elsewhere.
hospitals.risk_flag: Limited departments — medical oncology only, no radiation or surgical oncology on site

hospitals.name: Tata Medical Center
hospitals.notes: Part of Tata Memorial Centre network. Major referral centre for East India — serves patients from Bihar, Jharkhand, Odisha, Northeast. More accessible than TMH Mumbai for East India patients. Medium cost.

hospitals.name: Tata Memorial Hospital

contact.address: Dr. Ernest Borges Road, Parel, Mumbai - 400012

hospitals.notes: India's premier cancer centre. Government rates — highly affordable but very high patient volume and long wait times. Best for complex cases, second opinions, rare cancers, and when local treatment capacity is insufficient. Outstation patients need significant logistical planning.
hospitals.risk_flag: Long wait times — not suitable for urgent cases without prior referral coordination

hospitals.name: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi

contact.address: Sri Aurobindo Marg, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi - 110029

hospitals.notes: Top government medical institute. Extremely low cost. Very high volume — expect long waits for appointments. Book via ORS portal. Accessible from Bihar by train (Rajdhani/Shatabdi to Delhi). Strong for second opinions.

hospitals.name: Rajendra Institute of Medical Sciences
hospitals.notes: State government medical institute. Surgical Oncology OPD Mon/Thu; Radiation OPD Mon–Thu. Linear Accelerator installed. Free/subsidized care for state residents. Very high patient volume — plan for long waits.

hospitals.name: Ranchi Cancer Hospital and Research Centre

contact.address: Plot 580, Sukurhutu Road, Kanke, Ranchi - Jharkhand

hospitals.notes: Tata Trusts-operated dedicated cancer hospital — first super-speciality cancer hospital in Jharkhand. Inaugurated May 2023. 82 beds, PET-CT, Linear Accelerator + Brachytherapy, PMJAY accepted. Serves Jharkhand, Bihar, WB, Chhattisgarh, MP. Toll-free: 1800-313-4922.

hospitals.name: HCG Abdur Razzaque Ansari Cancer Hospital
hospitals.notes: Premier private cancer hospital in Jharkhand since 2008. PET-CT, Brachytherapy, full oncology spectrum including Pediatric Oncology. 24/7. High cost — verify PMJAY/insurance before visiting.

hospitals.name: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Deoghar
hospitals.notes: Central government AIIMS. Surgical Oncology and Radiation Oncology confirmed. Medical Oncology department ramping up (Senior Resident recruitment 2024). OPD Mon–Fri 8:30am–4:30pm, Sat till 2pm. Best option for Santhal Pargana and Jharkhand–WB border patients.

hospitals.name: Acharya Harihar Post Graduate Institute of Cancer
hospitals.notes: Odisha's primary government cancer referral centre — one of India's 25 Regional Cancer Centres. 507 beds. ALL hospital services are FREE except cabin charges. NIRAMAYA program provides free anti-cancer drugs. BPL/OSTF patients fully covered. Note: uses Odisha's BSKY state scheme, not central PMJAY — Bihar patients must check coverage.

hospitals.name: HCG Panda Cancer Hospital
hospitals.notes: Confirmed NCG member. 130 beds. Elekta Versa HD Linear Accelerator + PET-CT + Brachytherapy + Bone Marrow Transplant. Established 2002 — experienced team. Private rates — high cost; check insurance before visiting.

hospitals.name: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhubaneswar
hospitals.notes: Central government AIIMS. Full oncology departments including Pediatric Hematology-Oncology — only government institution providing specialised pediatric cancer care in the Odisha-Jharkhand-WB region (250-300 new pediatric cancer patients/year). Bone Marrow Transplant unit being established.

hospitals.name: Chittaranjan National Cancer Institute

contact.address: 37 SP Mukherjee Road, Hazra, Kolkata (also New Town, Rajarhat campus)

hospitals.notes: Central government cancer institute — confirmed NCG member, NABH + NABL certified. Two campuses: Hazra (200 beds, original) and New Town Rajarhat (460 beds, 2022, ultramodern with Robotic Surgery + PET-CT + BMT). Free for BPL patients; heavily subsidized for all. Accepts both PMJAY and Swasthya Sathi (WB state scheme). Top referral choice for East India after TMC Kolkata.

hospitals.name: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Kalyani
hospitals.notes: Central government AIIMS in Nadia district. Medical Oncology has 12-bed day care chemo ward. Linear Accelerator operational since Feb 2024 — radiation services are new and still scaling up. Weekly Multidisciplinary Tumour Board. Accessible for lower West Bengal and border patients. Surgical Oncology not yet independently confirmed.
hospitals.risk_flag: Radiation services only started Feb 2024 — capacity still ramping up

hospitals.name: HCG EKO Cancer Centre, New Town

contact.address: Action Area 1D, New Town, Kolkata, West Bengal

hospitals.notes: 88-bed dedicated cancer hospital. First in Eastern India with Radixact TomoTherapy. da Vinci Robotic Surgery. BMT unit. NABH Digital Health Silver 2024 — first in Eastern India. High cost — best for patients with corporate/mediclaim insurance. Note: West Bengal uses Swasthya Sathi, not central PMJAY.

hospitals.name: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Cancer Research Institute

contact.address: Nayabad, New Garia, Kolkata, West Bengal

hospitals.notes: Charitable trust hospital with explicit mission to serve poor and middle-class patients at affordable cost. Full oncology spectrum including HIPEC/PIPAC (surgical), Bone Marrow Transplant (allogenic + autologous), PET/SPECT. Affiliated with Jadavpur University. 24/7 subsidized pharmacy. 24 insurance providers accepted.

hospitals.name: Apollo Gleneagles Cancer Hospital, Kolkata

contact.address: Canal Circular Road, Kolkata, West Bengal

hospitals.notes: JCI + NABH accredited — sole JCI-accredited hospital in Eastern India. Robotic surgery, Radiosurgery (knifeless brain surgery — first in Eastern India). 325 beds, 33 centres of excellence. Best for patients with international insurance or those seeking JCI-level care. High private rates.

hospitals.name: Dr. Bhubaneswar Borooah Cancer Institute
hospitals.notes: Unit of Tata Memorial Centre — confirmed NCG member. Premier government cancer hospital for all 8 Northeast states (serves 45 million people). 311 beds. Full spectrum including BMT/SCT unit. Award-winning PMJAY implementation (ranked 3rd nationally). Established 1973. PG teaching institute. Accessible from Patna by direct train.

hospitals.name: Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Centre

contact.address: Naria Road, BHU Campus, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh

hospitals.notes: TMC unit on BHU campus — confirmed NCG member, ESMO designated centre. 352 beds, 6 radiation machines treating 350 patients/day (shared with HBCH). Handles adult solid tumours; blood cancers and pediatric cancers go to HBCH Varanasi (9 km away). Free/subsidized treatment, PMJAY accepted. Most accessible TMC for Bihar patients — 3 hrs from Patna by road.

hospitals.name: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital, Varanasi
hospitals.notes: TMC unit — confirmed NCG member. Companion to MPMMCC Varanasi (9 km apart). HBCH handles ALL blood cancers (leukemia, lymphoma) and pediatric cancers; adult solid tumours go to MPMMCC. Bone Marrow Transplant facility. 179 beds. Free/subsidized, PMJAY accepted. Bihar patients with leukemia or childhood cancers should come here, not MPMMCC.

hospitals.name: Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences
hospitals.notes: State government PG medical institute. Two Linear Accelerators, 32-bed chemo day care, 200+ brachytherapy cases/year. Palliative care clinics with home visits within 25km. ICMR-funded cancer registry. Note: not a dedicated cancer centre — less specialised than TMC Varanasi for cancer-only cases. Better suited for lower Bihar patients needing Lucknow referral.
